To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
personalization technologies are a means for firms to achieve competitive advantage.
personalization technologies are a process-oriented phenomenon.

personalization technologies are a means for firms to create value for customers and for themselves, but the value created is not a given, it depends on how the technologies are implemented, and the implementation depends on how firms manage the technologies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
personalization as a process, which we define as the continuous improvement of personalization capabilities.
the process of personalization.
the development of a process model of personalization that can be used as a basis for the design and implementation of effective personalization processes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
personalization is a process of creating and delivering products or services tailored to the individual needs of the consumer.
personalization is the process of tailoring products and services to meet the needs, interests and wants of individuals.
, in the future, personalization technologies will become an integral part of the business process and will be used by companies to create value for their customers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
personalization technologies can be viewed as a process, which can be improved through the use of customer feedback, resulting in the `virtual cycle' of personalisation.

personalization technologies can be seen as a process that is characterized by a number of stages and activities that are interrelated and iterative in nature, and that the process of personalization is a continuous process that is not necessarily completed in one go.
personalization technologies have a positive effect on customer satisfaction, customer loyalty, and company performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
companies should not only focus on the personalization technologies but also on the processes to support them.
the success of personalization technologies is not only determined by their technical capabilities, but also by the personalization processes that companies implement.
personalization processes are not only important for personalization technologies, but also for personalization strategies and personalization capabilities.
